notes: The main menu title fits on narrow phone screens instead of hiding behind the Play panel.
Watch Bots is gone from the menu: to watch the bots, choose Spectate in the Play vs Bots lobby.
The lobby keeps one size as people join, switch teams or spectate; the teams and settings scroll, and Leave and Start Match stay at the bottom.
